subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who doesn’t believe in the existence of God
solution:
The correct answer is "**Atheist**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Fatalist**: relating to or characteristic of the belief that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.
 
• **Egoist**: a self-centered or selfish person 
 
• **Atheist: **a person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods.
 
• **Hypocrite****: **a person who acts in contradiction to his or her stated beliefs or feelings
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, the "**atheist**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• **Example**: *John told his friends that he is an **atheist **__and shall not enter the church to seek blessings.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Fatalist**: इस विश्वास से संबंधित या विशेषता कि सभी घटनाएँ पूर्व निर्धारित हैं और इसलिए अपरिहार्य हैं।
 
• **Egoist**: एक आत्मकेंद्रित या स्वार्थी व्यक्ति
 
• **Atheist: ** एक व्यक्ति जो ईश्वर या देवताओं के अस्तित्व में विश्वास नहीं करता है या उसमें विश्वास नहीं करता है।
 
• **Hypocrite****: ** एक व्यक्ति जो अपने घोषित विश्वासों या भावनाओं के विपरीत कार्य करता है।
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, the "**atheist**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
